Frozen recovery v1 and current recovery 37520174911 / original 37507582946 runs remain untouched. No current run is rerun, cancelled or reclassified.

GUI archive create/extract/edit/password UX, actual portal returned-file roundtrip, per-app accessible trees, keyboard/screen-reader workflows, perceived video/audio and other codecs remain separate acceptance gates.

source_findings: Import is inert. Standalone execution requires exact /run/t location, explicit disposable flag, root, QEMU/KVM, Enforcing and matching live/installed cmdline. Imported run_checks retains guest guards; future adapter needs separate review.

Fresh approved role choices and actual/isolated MIME declarations are preconditions, never substitutes for GUI operations. Different user choices or pre-existing app state are refused rather than changed.

New GUI proof requires actual UID, numeric PID/start, exact /usr/bin role ELF and a new compositor client with visible geometry. Foot/FeatherPad/Celluloid require native Wayland; PCManFM/XArchiver record either observed Wayland or Xwayland.

Session discovery uses actual non-root Mango user/session and post-exec matching children to obtain IPC and DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY. Each synthetic keyboard action requires the proven client to be actually focused.

Pinned Mango source emits the queried PID/visible/geometry/protocol/focus fields. Pinned PCManFM source implements F4 current-folder terminal and Ctrl+L directory navigation with deferred folder-view focus; it does not invent a path-bar file-opening action.

Actual terminal marker binds UID/nonce; F4 marker binds UID/current folder/nonce. PCManFM activates a uniquely owned text fixture and proven FeatherPad must save exact requested UTF-8 bytes. Config values and window titles alone cannot satisfy the save/content oracle.

Archive helpers operate on owned nested binary/Unicode/empty-directory fixtures; full typed-tree and file SHA/length comparison detect extra/missing/type-changed members. Encrypted 7z has actual wrong-password returncode and nonempty-plaintext negative controls.
FFV1/PCM source sizes and decoded byte SHA comparisons are real command content oracles. Their distinct passing evidence survives later GUI player failure without clearing that failed gate.

Visible fresh Celluloid, exact local Unix IPC peer PID/UID, right fixture path, GUI libmpv renderer, nonnull audio output, audio/video params, finite changing fixture clock and mapped libmpv are required. This proves player state only after real guest execution; screenshots and sound need human review.

Portal FileChooser/OpenURI versions, current AT-SPI enabled reply, Unix bus address and registry query are explicitly bounded read-only reachability diagnostics, not chooser/application-tree/screen-reader acceptance.

Security interval requires Enforcing before/after, journal cursor, available audit-file interval, no audit-mode/loss-counter change and no observed new AVC. Missing collector data, rotation/truncation and collector failure remain failures. Pre-existing audit enabled=0 is recorded as telemetry-limited and is never enabled to pass.

Cleanup pins PID with pidfd before checking the full identity; recycled/unproved replacement is not signalled. Original copied preference hashes are rechecked. Cleanup or another gate failure remains in overall failed status; no direct fallback changes app/network/package/service policy.

Exact candidate inventory hash and every dependency NEVRA/architecture were independently compared. Required audit-rules/wtype/grim/glib2/ffmpeg-free names are present; retained header proof assigns auditctl to audit-rules and gdbus to glib2. These are inventory/header proofs, not guest PATH/interface execution.
